title.narrative: EU Regional Support to Protection-Sensitive Migration Management Systems in the Western Balkans - Phase III (contract 2)

description.narrative: The overall objective of the regional migration programme, of which this contract forms part, is to support the further development and strengthening of holistic and sustainable systems and capacities across the whole migration management process including identification, registration and referral at the border, asylum systems and reception capacities, as well as both voluntary and non-voluntary returns and alternatives to detention (ATD). This contract will be implemented by the European Union Agency for Asylum (EUAA).
